purpose: Source-backed interaction grammar for the monitor RCA graph and DIIKW sidebar.
scope: getbymonitor graph legibility, attention frontier, semantic zoom, evidence-path interaction, and operator-facing RCA UI.

sources.title: NodeXL - Network Overview, Discovery and Exploration in Excel
sources.monitor_use: Graph starts with ranked overview labels and keeps data/sidebar fallbacks instead of relying on spatial layout alone.

sources.title: Visualizing Networks - Microsoft Research
sources.monitor_use: Treat RCA graph interactions as analysis steps: select, inspect, compare, then choose the next probe/action.

sources.title: Measuring and improving the readability of network visualizations
sources.monitor_use: Keep selected/focused state and make exploration history an explicit future affordance.

sources.title: Data visualization style guidelines for Office Add-ins
sources.monitor_use: Non-color node encodings are preserved through Cytoscape shapes; layout animation is disabled where it caused renderer errors.

sources.title: Accessibility - Fluent 2 Design System
sources.monitor_use: Graph controls remain buttons with pressed states; labels and sidebars do not depend on color alone.

sources.title: Cytoscape.js
sources.monitor_use: Cytoscape owns the graph viewport, hit-testing, pan/zoom, classes, and style selectors inside a single React island.

sources.title: Using layouts - Cytoscape.js blog
sources.monitor_use: Cose layout remains the default, but overview labels are ranked so readability does not depend on perfect layout.

sources.title: cytoscape.js-expand-collapse
sources.monitor_use: Future local expansion should be reversible and branch-scoped, not a full graph reshuffle.

sources.title: Cytoscape.js: a graph theory library for visualisation and analysis
sources.monitor_use: Supports using Cytoscape as both an interactive graph layer and a future analysis substrate.

sources.title: Argo Lite: Open-Source Interactive Graph Exploration and Visualization in Browsers
sources.monitor_use: Selected-node focus now brightens 1-hop neighborhoods and keeps 2-hop context faint.

sources.title: Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection
sources.monitor_use: Future evidence updater can mark fresh pressure/thermal changes without pretending static samples prove root cause.

sources.title: DIVI: Dynamically Linking Views in Interactive Visualization
sources.monitor_use: Graph selection drives DIIKW sidebar context and should eventually synchronize evidence/model views bidirectionally.

sources.title: Responsive Matrix Cells: A Focus+Context Approach for Exploring and Editing Multivariate Graphs
sources.monitor_use: Focus mode dims unrelated graph context instead of removing it.

sources.title: Interaction techniques for selecting and manipulating subgraphs in network visualizations
sources.monitor_use: Selection treatment distinguishes selected node, direct neighborhood, branch edges, second hop, and unrelated faded context.

sources.title: Focus-plus-Context - InfoVis Wiki
sources.monitor_use: The graph keeps faint context around selected RCA branches rather than forcing a separate drilldown screen.

sources.title: What Is the Data, Information, Knowledge, Wisdom Pyramid?
sources.monitor_use: The right sidebar is organized as Data, Information, Intelligence, Knowledge, and Action.

sources.title: Ashby's Law of Requisite Variety
supports: response variety must match system variety
sources.monitor_use: The UI should preserve branch options while reducing simultaneous visual noise.

sources.title: Designing intuitive data experiences with graph visualisations
sources.monitor_use: The graph starts from operator questions: what happened, why, evidence strength, next safe action.

sources.title: Interaction - Fluent 2 Design System
sources.monitor_use: Button/control behavior follows simple pressed/selected states; expensive graph layout motion is gated by runtime safety.

rejected_or_deferred.reason: Useful for platform architecture research, but not directly relevant to monitor graph legibility.
Rendering substrate research only; Cytoscape is the current graph layer.
Too immature or weakly sourced for RCA graph architecture.

implementation_commitments: Default overview must not label every node.
Selected branches must preserve context instead of deleting surrounding graph state.
Motion is subordinate to runtime stability and evidence comprehension.
Color never carries the whole meaning; shape, label priority, sidebar text, and control state carry meaning too.
Raw data remains available, but the default operator path is interpretation-first.
